title: Today's top defense-tech headlines
big: 42 new stories since the last brief. The busiest areas: drones & air autonomy and maritime & undersea autonomy.

stories.h: Shield AI to acquire radar maker Echodyne to bust drones
stories.what: Shield AI's CEO said the purchase of Echodyne supports the company’s aim to branch into different areas of unmanned systems.
stories.you: Software that decides what to look at and what to hit is where the most value is moving.

stories.h: Ukraine eyeing new SpaceX Starshield deal by mid-2027, still no answers about October problems
stories.what: “I hope that the contract will be signed,” Ukraine’s Chargé d’Affaires Denys Sienik said, even as Kyiv considers potential alternatives to SpaceX.
stories.you: More of the military's sensing and communications now runs through orbit, and new suppliers are getting in.

stories.h: Europe nears decision on competing hypersonic interceptor programs
stories.what: The European Commission is expected to select one of two competing consortia by the end of November to advance development of a European interceptor targeting hypersonic and ballistic missile threats, with a system-level demonstrator targeted for 2030.
stories.you: Missile defense is one of the biggest budget lines this decade, and its software and sensors are open to newcomers.

stories.h: DOW’s DRPM-UxS Fielded $782M in Drones, Counter-UAS to CENTCOM
stories.what: DOW delivered 1,300 attack drones, 100 maritime vessels and 24,000 counter-drone systems to CENTCOM in 2026.
stories.you: Drones are becoming the military's default purchase, so volume, price and reliability decide who wins.

stories.h: It’s easier to buy new amphibious ships than fix old ones faster, say Navy, Marines
stories.what: With the average amphib sidelined more than half the time, the services have drawn up a plan to add 9 more instead.
stories.you: The Navy is short of ships and is turning to cheaper unmanned boats, which opens the door to new builders.

watch.why: November 10. Could squeeze drone, motor and munitions supply weeks before the DoD ban.

idea.why: Motors using ferrite or reluctance designs, or recycled magnets, for small drones and actuators. China controls heavy rare earths. A compliant motor is a chokepoint product every drone maker needs.
